Subgrid: Chrome 117, Firefox 71, Safari 16. 4. color-mix(): Chrome 111, Firefox 88, Safari 16.2. 5. CSS Nesting: Chrome 112, Firefox 117, Safari 16.5. Specification status for these is generally 'Working Draft' or 'Candidate Recommendation' (CR).
